name: Indiana Furniture
old_description: Created for everyday use in every situation, Rockstar features generous, contoured proportions and standout comfort for users of all sizes.
about:
Indiana Furniture operates from Jasper, Indiana, where it has manufactured office furniture for more than a century according to company statements. The business remains privately held, though ownership structure is not publicly detailed, and no founders are named in available materials.

The company produces a full line of workplace furniture including desks, workstations, seating, tables, space division screens, filing and storage, and accessories. It offers a product configurator for seating and occasional tables, a quickship program (iQ) that delivers select items in roughly two weeks at no surcharge, and custom design services. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Customers span corporate and commercial offices, federal agencies (via GSA schedules), state and local governments (through OMNIA, TIPS, and GOVMVMT contracts), and education markets. Sales are conducted through a network of independent representatives such as Interior Office Source in Michigan, Altitude Resource Group in the Mountain West, Pringle-Ward in New York City, and JL & Associates in the Pacific Northwest.

Indiana Furniture emphasizes that environmental sustainability and profitability have coexisted in its operations for over 100 years. Products carry BIFMA level and VOC certifications, and the company publishes Ecomedes documentation. The iQ quickship program, contract purchasing vehicles, and a nationwide rep network are presented as key differentiators.
